name: Auto Insta DM — Comment → Reply + DM

parameters.content:
## Auto Insta DM
Map products in `config/reel-message-map.csv` or Google Sheet.
Multiple reels/posts per product: separate links with `|` in reel_url.
Webhook: `{{WEBHOOK_URL}}/webhook/instagram-comments`

nodes.name: Public Reply: Please check your DM

parameters.url: =https://{{ $('Load Reel Map & Match').item.json.graphHost }}/{{ $('Load Reel Map & Match').item.json.graphVersion }}/{{ $env.META_IG_USER_ID }}/messages
parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ recipient: { comment_id: $('Load Reel Map & Match').item.json.commentId }, message: { text: $('Load Reel Map & Match').item.json.dmMessage } }) }}
